name: Dagger Axe Lancers
headerMeta: Heroic era · Cavalry · charge cav · 245 leadership · T4M
pitch: A cavalry charger that hits hard on flanks when spaced correctly, hampered by poor duelling and the removal of its old zero-momentum damage trait. On open maps it underperforms heavier chargers; on curved terrain like Western City it shines with intelligent pathing.

doctrines.name: Epic Charge Defence Doctrine
doctrines.note: −50% DMG taken while charging, −6s charge CD

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Recommended by Amya as the main veterancy pick.

battleRole.positioning: Position on the opposite side of the enemy push from your hero — let them follow your hero as you move behind or around the formation. {1}
battleRole.tips: Charge takes 1.5s to reach final stance for full damage; you have ~10s to push through a blob before skill 2 ends. {1} X-move or press 2 when units are 2-3s away from impact, then let them go through the blob (they follow your hero away). {1} If you cannot use the follow-charge effectively, default to a normal 1 charge and recall with skill 2 — but skill-2 priority should always be first choice. {1} Dodge pikes and take better fight angles when possible. {1} Lancer's Last Stand trick: if you spawn with it, swap away and swap back; if you just lost the unit, pull it from supply (best to have it out, swap to another unit, then swap back) so the 40%-at-60%-headcount damage applies to 100% of the unit. {1}

controls.notes: Old trait removed: the short-charge (max damage at 0 momentum) mechanic was deleted. New playstyle: press 2 early and maintain the charge to wipe in one go. {1} Most engagements follow: go in / position daggeraxe opposite your hero on the enemy push, X-move or press 2 when units are 2–3s from impact, let them follow through the blob. {1} Avoid the old pattern (charge first, then press 2) — follow-charge is the priority, always use skill 2 over basic charges when possible. {1}
